_note: 2026-11-10: the culture colourways (Reach meshes with culture textures) remade as their own pieces. Concept = kinds[kind] filled with cultures[culture] + suffix[kind's fit]; gpt-image-2-5-sunburst 1:1; 3D meshy-t2.5 smart topology + meshy-7 PBR (user OK'd T2.5 for these). Lore (UESP via Exa, 2026-11-10): Argonians weave grass sashes (a secret craft), use bone, shell, tortoise shell, jade, turquoise, feathers, spiral and geometric designs, a Sithis emblem at the navel; Ashlanders guar leather boiled stiff, netch hide, chitin, kresh/roobrush thread, several belts crossed on the diagonal, tribal enamels, racer plumes; Bosmer (Green Pact) harm no living plant: hide, bone, horn, sinew, insect silk and amber, meat-eaters' trophies; Khajiit: bright patterned cloth, crescent and full-moon shapes everywhere, jewellery, Anequina lunar imagery, Pellitine elegance; Kothringi: silver-skinned Nede descendants of Black Marsh, seafarers, silver, river pearl, reed; Lilmothiit: fox-folk nomads of coastal Black Marsh, woven fibre, shell, bright beads; Orcs: Malacath, iron, bear and wolf fur, tusks, bold blocky patterns; goblins: scavenged scraps, bone, rags, feathers; Reachmen: hide, sinew, bone, antler, hagraven feathers, red and black paint.

kinds.hide: A {adj} commoner's loincloth: {plain}, a long front flap and a long back flap, tied at the hips by {cord}, {plain_trim}.
kinds.fine: A {adj} chieftain's loincloth: {fine}, long front and back flaps edged with {fine_trim}, on {fine_belt}.
kinds.royal: A {adj} ruler's loincloth: {royal}, long front and back flaps decorated with {motif} and edged with {royal_trim}, on {royal_belt}.
kinds.grave: A {adj} burial loincloth taken from a grave: {plain}, rotted, faded and greyed, grave dirt and mould stains, the flap hems frayed and torn, a few small holes, tied by {cord} gone brittle.
kinds.skirt: A {adj} girl's wrap skirt: {plain} wrapped round the hips to just above the knee and tied at one side by {cord}, {plain_trim}.
kinds.band: A {adj} woman's chest wrap: a bandeau of {plain_soft} wound round the bust and tied at the centre front, {plain_trim}.
kinds.band_fine: A {adj} noblewoman's chest band: a bandeau of {fine}, edged top and bottom with {fine_trim}, {fine_clasp} at the centre front.
kinds.band_royal: A {adj} queen's chest band: a bandeau of {royal}, decorated with {motif}, {royal_clasp} at the centre front, {royal_trim} along the lower edge.
kinds.grave_band: A {adj} burial chest wrap taken from a grave: a bandeau of {plain_soft}, rotted, faded and greyed, grave dirt and mould stains, frayed torn edges, a few small holes.
kinds.war: A {adj} warrior's war belt: {war_belt}, hung with {trophy}, {war_extra}.
kinds.armour: A {adj} armoured skirt: {lames}, in separate overlapping panels at the front, back and both sides, split apart so the legs can move, down to mid-thigh, on {war_belt}.
kinds.duke: A {adj} duke's short apron: a stiff front apron to mid-thigh of {fine}, decorated with {motif}, edged with {fine_trim}, on {fine_belt}, and a short plain back flap.
kinds.king: A {adj} king's long aprons: a front and a back panel down to the knees of {royal}, woven with {motif}, a fringe of {fringe} at the hems, on {royal_belt}, a {feather} at one hip.
kinds.emperor: A {adj} emperor's regalia: long front and back aprons to below the knees of {imperial}, richly decorated with {motif} in {metal_thread}, a wide belt plaque of {metal} set with {gems}, the hems finished with a fringe of {fringe} and {metal} beads, short tasselled drapes at each hip.
kinds.tunic: A {adj} child's sleeveless tunic: {plain_soft} to mid-thigh, a plain round neck, belted at the waist by {cord}, {plain_trim}.
kinds.mantle: A {adj} ruler's mantle: a cape of {cape} falling from the shoulders to the calves behind, {cape_collar}, fastened at the chest by {cape_clasp}.
kinds.fur_robe: A {adj} fur robe: a heavy cape of {cape} with the fur left long and shaggy, falling from the shoulders to the calves behind, {cape_collar}, fastened across the chest by {cape_clasp} on a hide thong.
